title: Milestone accepted and invoiced

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
Milestone 2 of {customer}'s project was accepted on 20 March 2026, and Kalmira invoiced ₹15,00,000 the same day, payable in 30 days. Nothing has been paid by 31 March 2026. What does Kalmira show for the ₹15,00,000?

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.
explanation: A right to consideration that is unconditional, with only the passage of time before payment is due, is a receivable (para 108).

mistakes.feedback: Once the milestone is accepted, only time is left until the due date, so the right is unconditional: a receivable (para 108), not a contract asset.
Kalmira has done the work and is owed the money; it does not owe the customer anything.
